topic: Air Fryer Paper Liners vs Baker Signature Air Fryer Paper
angle: Head-to-head: which of these two is the smarter buy for most people?

reviews.title: Air Fryer Paper Liners
pros: Fits 4-6 quart round baskets perfectly; the 7.9-inch base keeps food off the heating element without riding up the sides.
Unbleached, chlorine-free paper with a non-stick coating that holds up to 400°F without scorching or flaking.
Drilled perforations allow consistent airflow, so you don't sacrifice crispiness for the sake of cleanup.

reviews.title: Baker Signature Air Fryer Paper
pros: Perforated design allows air circulation while catching grease, so food cooks evenly without sitting in drippings
True 8-inch square size fits most 4-6 quart baskets without the curling or up-the-walls misfit cheaper liners have
Sturdy parchment weight handles heavy items like chicken thighs and frozen mozzarella sticks without tearing on removal
